task.description: WF-03 Step Final (git merge) for ISS-0699, queue task 699, GH#1468 (already closed). On branch feature/WF03-ISS0699-20260917. Follow docs/agents/protocols/GIT_MERGE.md exactly, steps 1-10 (single-worktree checkout, not the worktree variant): stage/commit any remaining files, fetch+rebase onto origin/main, run mix format --check-formatted / mix compile --warnings-as-errors / mix test after rebase (attribute any failure structurally per core-directives.md -- this branch changed only scripts/test_parallel.sh and test/scripts/test_parallel_tmpdir_cleanup_test.sh, so any Elixir compile/test failure is almost certainly pre-existing/unattributable to this branch, but verify and state the attribution route explicitly rather than assuming), push the rebased branch (force-with-lease only if a plain push is rejected as non-fast-forward), open a PR (title prefix 'fix:'), wait for CI (backend+frontend jobs) to go green via `gh pr checks <PR>` in a bounded poll loop (check every 1-2 minutes, do not rely on an internally-armed monitor since the parent session cannot see it), then merge with `gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch`, then do the mandatory local cleanup (checkout main, pull --ff-only, delete local branch) and verify a clean tree. Note for step 2's PR body: SECURITY-REVIEWER's verdict was PASS/out-of-scope per handoffs/WF03-ISS0699-20260917/step-03b-security-reviewer.json. Claim by setting status to IN_PROGRESS.

result.summary: Rebase (no-op, already ahead of origin/main), mix format --check-formatted (PASS), mix compile --warnings-as-errors (PASS), full mix test (4331 passed, 1 failed -- test/letflow/routers/tenants_test.exs:356 pagination test, confirmed unrelated pre-existing flake, file-disjoint from this branch's diff) all cleared. Pushed branch (plain fast-forward, no rewrite since rebase was no-op) and opened PR #1469 (https://github.com/tvolodi/letflow/pull/1469). CI then surfaced a REAL, branch-attributable failure distinct from the local mix test run: the 'Backend gate (mix letflow.check)' job failed with 'mix letflow.check.test: FAILED -- partition log directory /tmp/letflow_test_parallel.gg5711 contains zero partition-*.log files.' Root cause traced in lib/mix/tasks/letflow.check.test.ex: that task shells out to scripts/test_parallel.sh, waits for it to exit 0, and THEN reads scripts/test_parallel.sh's own tmp_dir for partition-*.log files (for its ISS-0069 substring gate) -- but this branch's ISS-0699 fix (scripts/test_parallel.sh's new cleanup_tmp_dir() EXIT trap) deletes that same tmp_dir on any clean (exit 0) run before letflow.check.test ever gets a chance to read it. This is a genuine design gap in ISS-0699's fix: it never accounted for a downstream consumer reading the partition logs AFTER test_parallel.sh's own successful exit. Locally, `mix test` alone never exercises this path (it doesn't go through letflow.check.test), which is why this was not caught before CI. This failure IS attributable to this branch -- not a pre-existing flake -- so per GIT_MERGE.md step 5d this blocks the merge; --admin override is not authorized. PR #1469 left open, branch left pushed, NOT merged.

issues.description: scripts/test_parallel.sh's ISS-0699 cleanup_tmp_dir() EXIT trap deletes tmp_dir (and its partition-*.log files) on every clean exit, including when invoked by lib/mix/tasks/letflow.check.test.ex (mix letflow.check -> mix letflow.check.test -> scripts/test_parallel.sh), which reads those same partition-*.log files AFTER the script exits 0 for its own ISS-0069 warning-substring gate. Result: 'mix letflow.check.test: FAILED -- partition log directory ... contains zero partition-*.log files' on every clean CI run since this fix landed on the branch. Needs a design fix (e.g. delay cleanup until letflow.check.test has read the logs, or have that task's own invocation set TEST_PARALLEL_KEEP_LOGS and clean up itself) -- not something to patch ad hoc at Step Final without going back through CODE-DESIGNER/CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR per this project's own gates. CI job: https://github.com/tvolodi/letflow/actions/runs/35155640353/job/104994345545
